description: This file defines a template class HashTableBase for high-performance, compact hash tables using open addressing with power-of-two bucket sizes. It includes detailed implementation of lookup, insertion, deletion, and resizing mechanisms, along with iteration support. The code emphasizes performance and strict usage conditions, and provides usage examples for derived classes.

classes.name: HashTableBase
classes.description: A template class implementing a high-speed, compact hash table with open addressing, supporting insertion, lookup, deletion, and iteration, designed for trivial node types.

methods.name: NodeLookup
methods.description: Performs a hash table lookup for a node matching a given hash and comparison predicate, returning a mutable pointer to the node or insertion point.

methods.name: UpdateAfterInsert
methods.description: Updates hash table state after inserting a new node, resizing if necessary.

methods.name: UpdateAfterRemoval
methods.description: Updates hash table state after removing a node, currently does not shrink the table.

methods.name: GrowBuckets
methods.description: Resizes and rehashes the bucket array to maintain performance.

methods.name: NodeClear
methods.description: Clears the hash table, freeing memory and resetting state.
